Our Story

Redefining Reliability in Freight

Plainsmark Transport is a premier trucking and logistics provider based in Green Bay, Wisconsin. Founded with a vision to redefine reliability in the freight industry, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for businesses across the nation.

Our strategic location allows us to efficiently manage routes throughout the Midwest and beyond. We understand that in logistics, promises matter. That's why we invest heavily in our fleet, our technology, and most importantly, our people. Every mile we drive is backed by a commitment to safety and communication.

Our Mission

To provide safe, efficient, and reliable transportation solutions that exceed customer expectations while fostering a supportive and rewarding environment for our team members.

Our Vision

To be the carrier of choice for shippers who value integrity and performance, setting the standard for excellence in the American trucking industry.
